description: Pre/post action eligibility snapshots are modulated by discounted return advantages against a per-time-step baseline, then applied as bounded X updates.

learning.reward_signal: discounted return-to-go at each action minus a running baseline for that time step; baseline updates after the episode
learning.post_credit: Decoded action event centered by its softmax probabilities; competing columns receive negative eligibility.
learning.stdp_polarity: active pre -> selected post: +A_plus; active pre -> competing posts: -A_minus
learning.updates_applied_per_completed_episode: always when reward-modulated eligibility is nonzero
